import pytest
from docs.service import Document, edit_document, UnauthorizedError


def test_unauthorized_user_cannot_edit():
    doc = Document(id="d1", owner_id="user1", content="old")
    with pytest.raises(UnauthorizedError):
        edit_document("intruder", doc, "hacked")
    assert doc.content == "old"
explanation: Constructs a third party who is neither owner nor shared and asserts edit_document rejects the edit and leaves content unchanged. No existing test drives an unauthorized identity, which is why removing the guard survived.
rationale: pytest.raises(UnauthorizedError) for a non-owner, non-shared user is the assertion that detects the missing guard.
